brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent whose child is starting to explore cupboards. Help them consider the kit as part of preparing their home. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research. Do not imply any lock fits every cupboard or that the kit replaces supervision.

variants.concept: A kit for more than cupboard doors
variants.primary_text: When your child starts exploring cupboards, it may be time to prepare more than one spot. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks, edge and corner protectors, socket guards and door guards. It’s listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 off when you pay prepaid. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Prepare your home with a 6-in-1 kit

variants.primary_text: Want help with installation as you prepare for a child exploring cupboards? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit comes with 1-to-1 installation video support. variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 installation video support

variants.primary_text: As your child begins exploring cupboards, a childproofing kit is one part of getting the home ready.
